review_locator: PMCID:PMC11144103, Group 3 innate lymphoid cells in intestinal health and disease; PMCID:PMC8842850, Group 3 innate lymphoid cells produce the growth factor HB-EGF to protect the intestine from TNF-mediated inflammation
primary_title: Group 3 innate lymphoid cells produce the growth factor HB-EGF to protect the intestine from TNF-mediated inflammation
decision_basis: The review identifies the Zhou primary showing that IL-1beta stimulates sorted intestinal ILC3s to produce PGE2, measured in culture supernatants by ELISA, providing an upstream inflammatory-to-prostanoid output bridge.
limitations_preserved: Measured prostanoid protein-output bridge; preserve recombinant IL-1beta, mouse intestinal ILC3 and supernatant-ELISA context, and do not infer a specific IL1 receptor, traumatic-SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effect.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC11144103, Group 3 innate lymphoid cells in intestinal health and disease; PMCID:PMC8842850, Group 3 innate lymphoid cells produce the growth factor HB-EGF to protect the intestine from TNF-mediated inflammation
primary_title: Group 3 innate lymphoid cells produce the growth factor HB-EGF to protect the intestine from TNF-mediated inflammation
decision_basis: The review identifies the Zhou primary showing that PGE2 is sufficient to induce Hbegf expression in sort-purified intestinal ILC3s and that an EP2 antagonist blocks the response.
limitations_preserved: Gene-expression bridge only; preserve the mouse intestinal ILC3 and PGE2/EP2 context, distinguish Hbegf transcript from pro-HB-EGF protein, and do not infer translation, shedding, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effect.

primary_title: Group 3 innate lymphoid cells produce the growth factor HB-EGF to protect the intestine from TNF-mediated inflammation
decision_basis: The review identifies the Zhou primary showing that EP2 agonism increases HB-EGF-positive ILC3s in vivo and increases pro-HB-EGF protein in sorted ILC3s by immunoblot.
limitations_preserved: Protein-expression bridge; preserve EP2 agonist, pro-HB-EGF membrane-bound form and mouse intestinal ILC3 context, distinguish it from soluble shedding and from the PGE2-to-Hbegf transcript row, and do not infer SCI or terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC11144103, Group 3 innate lymphoid cells in intestinal health and disease; PMCID:PMC8842850, Group 3 innate lymphoid cells produce the growth factor HB-EGF to protect the intestine from TNF-mediated inflammation
primary_title: Group 3 innate lymphoid cells produce the growth factor HB-EGF to protect the intestine from TNF-mediated inflammation
decision_basis: The review identifies the Zhou primary showing that ILC3-derived HB-EGF is required for protection of intestinal epithelium from TNF-induced death, while recombinant HB-EGF protects CMT-93 epithelial cells through ErbB1 and Akt; ILC3-specific Hbegf deletion increases epithelial death in vivo.
limitations_preserved: Functional protein-output bridge; preserve ILC3-derived HB-EGF, mouse epithelial and TNF-exposure context, and ErbB1/Akt as a bounded downstream mechanism, without claiming direct source-cell shedding, universal epithelial protection, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effects.
